plugin.tsimport.title: Import from TorrServer
plugin.tsimport.import_hint: Adds the TorrServer torrents that Silo does not have yet, with their titles, posters and categories.
plugin.tsimport.password_hint: Leave the field empty to keep the saved password. Username and password are only needed if TorrServer has authentication turned on.
plugin.tsimport.auto_hint: Only new torrents are added: a torrent you deleted in Silo does not come back. The check runs when Silo starts and then at the set interval.
plugin.tsimport.url_invalid: Enter the TorrServer address, for example http://127.0.0.1:8090
plugin.tsimport.interval_invalid: The interval must be from 1 to 1440 minutes
plugin.tsimport.err_no_url: The TorrServer address is not set.
plugin.tsimport.err_unreachable: TorrServer does not respond. Check the address and that TorrServer is running.
plugin.tsimport.err_unauthorized: TorrServer rejected the username or password.
plugin.tsimport.err_bad_answer: The address does not lead to TorrServer: the answer is not a torrent list.
plugin.tsimport.err_add_failed: Some torrents could not be added.
